newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka stocks end little moved due to mismatch.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka stocks end little moved due to mismatch.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed little changed on Monday in thin trade, brokers said.
The all share index closed 1.4 points up at 824.8, with price gains edging out losses by 33 to 26. Aitken Spence & Co rose four rupees to 204, Hayleys Ltd one to 276.
"There were buyers but no sellers for stocks which are expected to see good croporate results for the period to June 30," said a broker at Lanka securities.
The opposite was true of stocks which were expected to turn in an indifferent performance for the same period, brokers said.

Turnover was 27.6 million rupees, led by 100,200 shares of Asian Hotels, 24,000 Grain Elevators, 5,200 John Keells Holdings, 106,000 Mercantile Leasing, 40,000 Sampath Bank, 101,000 Vanik Incorporation.
"Retailers who generally move prices were quiet today due to the cricket," said a broker at John Keells.
Retail participation was down to a minimum as Sri Lanka played their first match in a four-nation tournament against Pakistan in Colombo on Monday, brokers said.
